headline: Travel expense reimbursement policy, cell phone ban procedure, and revisions to policies on discrimination, child abuse reporting, and AED and CPR.
summary: The agenda lists a new travel expense reimbursement policy, a draft BHS cell phone ban procedure, and several policies to review or revise. It also includes an executive session on CEMP.
